correctness.rationale: For n>=3, exactly n or n-1 matching edges occur. The remaining same-label intersection t at unmatched size m has m²-t feasible edges, with t(t-1),2t(m-t),(m-t)² transitions to t-2,t-1,t. This gives the exact rational failure recurrence; at m=2, failure probability is (1/3)Pr(T_2=1). The normalized expectation telescoping and second-factorial-moment survival bounds prove p_n=2/n+O(log(n)/n²); independent rational dynamic calculations matched p_3=1/3,p_4=p_5=4/21,p_6=172/1029. Uniform maximal matchings count D_n perfect and nD_{n-1} near-perfect, giving asymptotic 1/2. These are infinite arguments, not extrapolated computations.
residual_risks: Finite checks are corroboration only; the analytic proof supplies the quantified claim.
Publication dates are Nov2 and Nov8; no claim of intra-day priority for the two Nov8 independent formulations.
Additional comparison of uniform maximal matching to randomized output is a standard derangement exercise and does not restore independent value.
